description: Cases for the summary. Start from a copy of contracts/ (or an empty directory when `empty` is true), add `files`, and summarize the directory. `text` is what the summary command prints, character for character: a header and one line per fixture, the first three columns padded with spaces to the longest cell (in UTF-16 code units), columns separated by two spaces. `rows` is the number of fixtures. With `depth`, summarize with that depth (the option --depth of the command).

cases.case: bodies of every form, a fixture that does not follow the format, and keys that need quotes
depth 1 (the default): two bodies with the same keys at the top look the same
depth 2: the objects inside the body are opened; arrays and what lies deeper are not
config: a fixture that holds what the configuration forbids does not follow the format
config: a configuration that is not valid forbids nothing; the check reports it
